claim_boundary: Every retained source part compiled with CPU fallback disabled and its framework trace binds all source nodes to QNN HTP for SM8550/V73. This is target-specific host AOT evidence, not physical Android execution or benchmark evidence.

rewrites.lm_head: 128,000 logits split into 22 HTP chunks; CPU performs only global greedy reduction
rewrites.memory_bounded_pipeline: 30 layers split into core/norm, MLP projection/activation/down, and residual contexts
rewrites.rotary_and_gqa: standard one-token RoPE and causal grouped-query attention with explicit left-aligned cache state
rewrites.wide_mlp: 10,752 split as 6,144 + 4,608; second down-projection input/weights zero-padded to 6,144

explicit_cpu_operations: selected-row asymmetric Q4 token embedding dequantization
global greedy argmax across HTP LM-head chunks
route.quantization: symmetric INT4 block-32 weights lowered by QNN EP block-quant optimization
route.state: 22 explicit convolution caches plus 8 explicit attention K/V pairs
